messages:
maya_ops: Packaging heads-up — preparing a delta patch from 1.4.3 -> 1.4.4 for Private/VPC installer. Target delivery window: Wed 03:00-06:00 UTC. Need ops + release ack and cosign key check. Who's oncall?

alex_k: Ack, I'm oncall until 04:00 UTC. Please attach sha256 and cosign proofs. Also we need image-digest pinning for offline registries.

packager-bot: delta bundle created: s3://redwood-private/installs/1.4.4/delta-1.4.3-1.4.4.tar.gz
sha256: 3b9f7d1c8b9e4f2d5a6c7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8
cosign: signed by key: projects/redwood-kms/key1

Verify commands:
```
sha256sum delta-1.4.3-1.4.4.tar.gz
cosign verify --key kms://projects/redwood-kms/key1 s3://redwood-private/installs/1.4.4/delta-1.4.3-1.4.4.tar.gz
```

sara_pm: I'll draft release notes. Any immediate customer-impact bullets? We should call out delta-only path and fallback to full image.

tj_release: +1 on digest pinning. For offline registries we must pin all base images in the shrinkwrap manifest. If delta fails we fallback to full-image install (signed). Canary customers: Cust-A, Cust-B.

maya_ops: Canary set to Cust-A -> Cust-B. I'll publish manifest entry and preload keys. Manifest snippet below (for shrinkwrap ingestion):
```
- product: redwood-installer
  version: 1.4.4
  type: delta
  base_version: 1.4.3
  distro: linux-amd64
  artifacts:
    - url: s3://redwood-private/installs/1.4.4/delta-1.4.3-1.4.4.tar.gz
      sha256: 3b9f7d1c8b9e4f2d5a6c7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8
    - image: registry.private/redwood/runner@sha256:abc123def456
```

deploy-bot: Deploy plan created: plan_id=dp-2024-11-03-01
Change window: Wed 03:00-06:00 UTC
Canary: Cust-A -> Cust-B
Rollback playbook: https://docs.internal/redwood/rollback/delta-vs-full
Flags: `canary=true`, `force-full=false`

[~15m later]

tj_release: update: Cust-A preflight failed during delta apply: error mounting overlay: "permission denied" on /var/lib/redwood. Logs: `ERR mount overlay: syscall EPERM`

maya_ops: Ack. Quick remediation? If not, abort delta and proceed with full-image rollout. @alex_k how long to republish signed full image and update shrinkwrap?

alex_k: We already have the full 1.4.4 image from CI (digest: sha256:ff12a4c9d0e3b2f4a6c8d9e0b1c2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0). I can republish to private registry and update shrinkwrap in ~8m. Will rotate manifest pins.

packager-bot: full-image artifact published: s3://redwood-private/installs/1.4.4/full-installer-1.4.4.tar.gz
sha256: ff12a4c9d0e3b2f4a6c8d9e0b1c2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0
cosign: signed by key: projects/redwood-kms/key1

deploy-bot: Aborting delta canary per request. Setting `force-full=true` and triggering full rollout. Notifying on-call.

sara_pm: Adding an emergency note to release notes: "Delta upgrade from 1.4.3 -> 1.4.4 aborted for some airgapped customers due to mount-permission edge-case; recommending full installer path. Customer support to coordinate imports."

maya_ops: Thanks — I'll run the rollback playbook and kick off the full-image rollout. Will post status updates.

alex_k: Filing a postmortem for packaging/installer team to investigate overlay permission mismatch. Assigning to @alex_k and @maya_ops.

deploy-bot: Full rollout started at 1738002000. ETA to finish canary -> 30m.

sara_pm: :thumbsup:
